claim: An outbox state of delivered with no received_at and no ok is not a receiver receipt. A cleared last_error does not prove the other host stored the file.

decisions.notes: Nine Mac outbox records flipped to delivered at 2026-11-15T11:26:57Z with received_at and ok still empty.
